title: [ingest] Worktree paths guarded by an O_EXCL per-path lease, 1h stale window
summary: createWorktree writes <wt>.lease atomically with the 'wx' (O_EXCL) flag so the first writer wins; a racing second agent gets {ok:false, held}. Re-entrant for the same pid. A lease is reclaimable only when its owner pid is dead AND aged past ORCH_LEASE_STALE_MS (3600000ms / 1h default) — so a crashed agent never wedges a path forever.
